name: Depilatory
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Commonly used among religious orders encouraging shaved heads, depilatory removes all hair from selected parts of the body and prevents it from starting to regrow for 24 hours.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
